sources.citation: hand-made by S18 for the O-52 line (online 6-max 100bb, BTN opens 2.5bb, BB calls) from common public 6-max conventions of opening and defending widths; not derived from any reference tool or captured data (O-26, O-83, O-201)

notes: The BTN range is an opening range of about 43 percent of hands; the BB range is a flatting range against a 2.5bb open, without the hands that would usually 3-bet (QQ+, AK, AQs).
Benchmark input only (O-201): the first real build runs on reference ranges in S20 (O-41).
